baseline.label: A — baseline (smart_format + interim)
baseline.notes: Default after Mac A/B (fastest/most natural). Full smart formatting on finals; interim partials on. Kept as default until per-show Transcription style ships.

punctuate.label: B — punctuate only (no smart_format)
punctuate.notes: Punctuation + capitalization without ITN. Mac A/B: perceptible delay vs baseline. Retained for upcoming show-level Transcription style (e.g. Polished).

punctuate_endpointing.label: C — punctuate + endpointing 300ms
punctuate_endpointing.notes: Same as B + endpointing 300. Mac A/B: worse than plain punctuate (line breaks felt off). Retained for reference only.
